create_uma_finetune_dataset: run the CLI script to create a UMA fine-tuning dataset from ASE atoms directories with energy force or stress regression tasks
create_yaml_data_task: create a YAML data task config file with normalizer RMSD, element references, and train-val dataset paths
create_yaml_finetune_config: create a UMA fine-tune YAML config file with the base model name and dataset-specific configuration
launch_processing_train_val: launch parallel processing of ASE atoms objects from train and val directories into the output directory
compute_normalizer_and_linear_reference: compute the force RMS normalizer and linear reference coefficients from processed training data
